		Data as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	procedureName: '[SelectData]',
	schemaName: '[AutoTerm]',
	resultSet: true,
	format: 'procedure',
	staged:false) ~> SourceQuery
SourceQuery sink(input(
		Record as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		Record = Data)) ~> OutputFile
